implementation: Grammar selection selector @Nat adds explicit priority independently of existing style declarations. Form, Leaf and dynamic HeadShape descriptors, compilation, semantic identity and bootstrap share the same selection-rule contract. Duplicate selectors and overflowing priorities return located compiler errors.

The region operation retains canonical bundle/node ownership, field positions, token-local View paths, explicit reader Capture/Presentation facts, logical source positions and source-map quality. Selection uses the smallest containing half-open range, descending priority, descending depth and declaration order.

RegionKey combines the existing AnalysisKey with a canonical reader-sidecar digest. SyntaxOnly and ReaderFacts are distinct capabilities. Native and initial CBOR sidecar validation enforce selected entry, token/trivia correspondence and owner-local source-map geometry without claiming provider execution authentication.

Complete portable replies are recomputed against the prepared input; stale keys, invalid scalar boundaries, malformed sidecars and resource stops preserve typed failure categories. Zero-width recovery regions are retained and do not become a selectable fabricated node.

Native typed region construction accounts for source, work, allocation, nodes and depth. OutputBytes applies when actual CBOR bytes are produced, including canonical identity hashing. Native Report usage is not a transport total. The CI WASI job now executes the eight region integration tests.
